content.title: Network & Port Documentation
content.content:
All required network ports are documented in SnapLogic's Groundplex Configuration Guide, provided to {{customer_name}}'s network team prior to deployment. The primary connectivity requirement is a single outbound HTTPS/WSS connection (port 443) from each Ground Plex node to SnapLogic's Manager endpoint. No inbound ports are required on the {{customer_name}} network perimeter.

[TABLE:simple:Required Network Ports]
| Port | Direction | Protocol | Purpose | Priority |
|------|-----------|----------|---------|----------|
| **P-01 MANDATORY** | Outbound | HTTPS/WSS (443) | Ground Plex → SnapLogic Manager | Critical |
| **P-02 (scaling)** | Internal | Custom | Ground Plex node-to-node communication (for clustered mode) | Optional |
| **P-03 (HA)** | Internal | Custom | Health check and failover coordination | Optional |
| **P-04 (OpenShift)** | Internal | Kubernetes API | OpenShift pod orchestration | Required |
| **P-05 (network ports)** | Outbound/Internal | Various | Connectivity to {{customer_name}} data sources (SAP, Oracle, APIs, file systems) | Required |
| **P-06 (autonomous deployment)** | Outbound | HTTPS (443) | CI/CD pipeline promotion via SnapLogic Migration API | Optional |
[/TABLE]
